name: Eternal Conquest
detailed_description:
The world is vast, and adventure waits around every corner! Step into a fast-paced journey where you’ll face off against unforgiving creatures, sharpen your reflexes, and grow stronger with every challenge you overcome. Build your hero one step at a time, gather gear, earn experience, and team up with fellow adventurers to take on what lies ahead!

Eternal Conquest is a cooperative bullet-hell MMORPG built around quick thinking, precise dodging, and nonstop action. The deeper you go, the tougher it gets — with every new zone bringing fresh patterns to dodge, harder enemies to outmaneuver, and greater rewards to earn.

HIGH-STAKES PROGRESSION

Each adventure counts. If your hero is defeated, you’ll need to start fresh — but with every run, you’ll become faster, smarter, and better equipped for what’s next.

UNIQUE CLASSES

Choose from a variety of distinct classes, each with their own playstyle, abilities, and gear. Whether you prefer long-range precision, up-close strength, or tactical support, there’s a class that fits your path.

GUILDS & CO-OP PLAY

Form a guild, invite your friends, or meet new allies along the way. Coordinate strategies, share progress, and take on bigger challenges together — no hero has to go it alone.

PLAYER-DRIVEN MARKET

Trade and thrive in a marketplace run entirely by players. Find rare gear, offload your extras, or seek out that one perfect item to complete your build.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with standard audio devices.
  • VR Support: No VR support.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with standard audio devices.
  • VR Support: No VR support.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains frequent cartoonish violence involving defeating fantasy creatures as part of gameplay progression.
